elements.element: Customer is not prohibited from soliciting Vendor employees or personnel.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause is blank, so the original restriction on Customer has been deleted and no non-solicitation obligation binds Customer.

elements.element: Customer must be prohibited from soliciting Vendor personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no operative non-solicitation obligation on Customer.

elements.element: Vendor must be prohibited from soliciting Customer personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no operative non-solicitation obligation on Vendor.

elements.element: Any covered personnel must be limited to personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: There is no operative non-solicitation restriction and therefore no broader class of covered personnel; the condition requiring this limitation is absent.

elements.element: Any post-involvement non-solicitation period must end no later than 12 months after the relevant individual's involvement in the Services ends.
elements.evidence: There is no operative non-solicitation period, so no restriction extends beyond the permitted 12-month limit.

elements.element: General advertisements must be excluded from prohibited solicitation.
elements.evidence: Because no solicitation is prohibited, recruitment through general advertisements remains permitted without an express carve-out.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches must be excluded from prohibited solicitation.
elements.evidence: Because no solicitation is prohibited, unsolicited approaches remain permitted without an express carve-out.

elements.element: Hiring or employing personnel must not be independently prohibited.
elements.evidence: Deletion removes the original prohibitions on hiring and employing; no no-hire restriction remains.

result.reason: The blank rendered clause operatively deletes the one-way non-solicit and no-hire, fully achieving the preferred position with no additional changes. It does not independently satisfy the fallback because it creates neither direction of the required mutual non-solicit, although all fallback limitations and exclusions are effectively respected because no restriction remains. The non-operative margin comment does not supply missing fallback duties.
